title: Positive probability under coordinate restriction
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^{n+1}\to\{-1,1\}$. The uniform probability that $f$ equals $1$ is the average of the corresponding probabilities for the two restrictions obtained by fixing the first coordinate to $1$ and to $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued function on the $(n+1)$-dimensional Boolean cube
